title: brand(runtime): "ObjectOS Cloud" wherever a user reads it — CLI help, cli.mdx, Console cloud-install i18n and README:322 still say "ObjectStack Cloud"; add a "Powered by ObjectStack" mark to the open-source Console (ruling 2026-10-26)
body:
Filing gate ③: a maintainer-directed task. Maintainer (Sam, `os-zhuang`), 2026-10-26, verbatim: 「还是 ObjectStack 的运行时就叫 ObjectOS ，社区版免费，然后企业版是收费的」, then chose 「模型 2：ObjectOS 三版本」 on the decision card 「采用「ObjectOS 一个产品三个版本，ObjectStack 是协议与框架名」吗？」 (13:18Z). The model: ObjectOS = the product a user sees, in three editions (Community = this repository's runtime + Console, free; Cloud; Enterprise); ObjectStack = the protocol, SDK, CLI and framework name developers program against. Business reason: one product name on every screen and in every help string is what lets the price list and the sales deck say one thing; today a Console user who clicks "install to cloud" reads "ObjectStack Cloud" while the site, the docs and the cloud itself say "ObjectOS Cloud". Reader: triage grades and, since the surface crosses `packages/cli` (server lane), `ui/packages/i18n` + `ui/apps/console` (ui lane) and `content/docs` (devx), names one lane or splits; one dev per resulting card. Dedupe: issue search "ObjectStack Cloud ObjectOS Cloud product name CLI i18n Powered by" → 10 hits, none open on the strings below; #24887 (closed: `OS_PRODUCT_NAME` docs), #9252 (closed: `branding.stage` plumbing) are the branding neighbours. Session `session_01FMuBZmssbfQkVrKRtxNvng`; siblings: objectstack-ai/objectos (edition model, README + TRADEMARK), www.objectos.ai#285 (pricing gains a Community column), #26129 (root README; its scope comment names the one sentence that changes there).

## Reading at `main` 679fc7ce (grep, excluding node_modules/dist/CHANGELOG)

| Surface | Says | Occurrences |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts` lines 5, 301, 307; `packages/cli/src/commands/cloud/whoami.ts`; `packages/cli/README.md` lines 83, 89, 149 | "ObjectStack Cloud" | 9 |
| `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` | "ObjectStack Cloud" | 6 |
| `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{en,de,es,fr,ja,ko,pt,ru,ar,…}.ts` — `Connected to ObjectStack Cloud`, `signed into ObjectStack Cloud`, `sign into ObjectStack Cloud first`, … | "ObjectStack Cloud" | 4 per locale, 10 locales |
| `README.md` line 322 | "target an ObjectStack Cloud control plane" | 1 |
| `ui/apps/console/public/logo.svg`, `manifest.json`; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/runtime-config.ts` line 332 default `productName: 'ObjectOS'` | "ObjectOS" | kept — this is the Community edition's wordmark, by the ruling |

For comparison the cloud repository's own UI strings say "ObjectOS Cloud" 84 times and "ObjectStack Cloud" 25 times; the public site and docs.objectos.ai say "ObjectOS Cloud" only.

## Scope

1. Every user-facing string above reads "ObjectOS Cloud" (the control-plane URL flag's description, the API-key description, `whoami` output, the CLI README table, `cli.mdx`, the ten locale files, README line 322). Internal identifiers (`@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY`, `~/.objectstack/cloud.json`, the cloud repository's name) do not change; CHANGELOGs are history and are not edited.
2. The open-source Console shows a small "Powered by ObjectStack" mark (link to objectstack.ai) where the server-pushed branding does not already brand the deployment — the sign-in layout (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/AuthLayout.tsx`, which already reads the server-driven product name) and the Console's About / footer surface, whichever the ui lane names as the one place. Cloud and Enterprise keep their server-pushed branding untouched (`branding.productName` via `@objectstack/cloud-connection` `runtime-config-plugin.ts`).
3. The default `productName` stays `'ObjectOS'`; `admin@objectos.ai` stays. ⛔ Do not rename the open-source wordmark to ObjectStack — that was option A of the earlier card and the maintainer chose otherwise.

## Premises (re-check before dispatch)

- P1 — `grep -rn "ObjectStack Cloud" packages/cli/src content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx README.md | wc -l` → 12 (±1).
- P2 — `grep -c "ObjectStack Cloud" ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` → 4.
- P3 — `grep -n "productName: 'ObjectOS'" ui/packages/app-shell/src/runtime-config.ts` → line 332.

## Acceptance

- `git grep -n "ObjectStack Cloud" -- ':!**/CHANGELOG.md' ':!**/node_modules/**'` → only internal identifiers or none; `os cloud login --help` and `os package publish --help` print "ObjectOS Cloud".
- `pnpm check:i18n` and the i18n coverage guards green across the ten locales; a changeset for `@objectstack/cli` and `@object-ui/i18n` (published packages; user-visible strings).
- The Community Console renders "Powered by ObjectStack" on the sign-in page in a fresh `os dev --ui`; a deployment that pushes `branding.productName` still shows its own name with no second brand line unless the ui lane decides the mark is edition-independent.

## 维护者速读

按你 13:18 的裁决（ObjectOS 三版本，ObjectStack 是协议与 SDK 名）：把残留在 CLI 帮助、部署文档、Console 云安装对话框十个语言、README 第 322 行里的「ObjectStack Cloud」统一为「ObjectOS Cloud」；开源 Console 保留 ObjectOS 字标不动，加一个「Powered by ObjectStack」小角标指向开发者站。内部标识符和 CHANGELOG 不动。
